signals.message: The public registry snapshot contains at least one repository whose current GitHub visibility is private. Rebuild the public bundle from live visibility before publishing repository-level details.
Persistent deep scanning of private repositories requires an Actions credential with access to those repositories; the default per-repository GITHUB_TOKEN cannot provide account-wide private access.
